findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 15 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 14 questions numbered 1-14; by section: u-introduction-qualitative-and-quantitative-analysis-four-step 1, 15.1~2 3, 15.2 2, 15.3 2, u-chromatography-duplicate-number-15-3 1, 15.3.1 1, 15.3.3 3, 15.4 1.

Theory parts cover qualitative and quantitative analysis, filtration of a salt-sand mixture, filter paper and fluted paper, Gooch and sintered glass crucibles, the principle and steps of crystallization with decolourizing and drying, simple distillation of sea water, fractional distillation of ethanol-water and petroleum, chromatography and its types, ascending paper chromatography, locating agents and Rf values, and the purity of aspirin. Two Rf numericals use made-up distances recomputed in Python. The exercise's descriptive questions (simple vs fractional distillation, criteria for a crystallization solvent, principle and uses of paper chromatography) are not repeated. Book corrections followed: Rf (not 'Rr'), Rf(C) = x'/y, H₂SO₄ catalyst, condenser water in at the lower end.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
